english.title: Fail to comply with hold notice relating to the export of relevant livestock
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a hold notice served in accordance with regulation 5 of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Enforcement Regulations 2024 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)

english.notes:
(i) A hold notice may be served under regulation 5 of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Enforcement Regulations 2024 where an inspector considers relevant livestock are being exported, or are to be exported from Great Britain under section 1 of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Act 2024.
(ii) See regulation 14 for offences by bodies corporate.
(iii) See regulation 16 for the power of prosecution afforded to a local authority.
